item.title: Agathias #9655 the Blood-handed went up to the Mist-terraces and asked the Pythia. Chewing
item.description: Agathias #9655 the Blood-handed went up to the Mist-terraces and asked the Pythia. Chewing laurel, she said: "Wooden walls alone will stand, when the spears of the Field of Ares are counted." Philides #6841 will interpret it.

item.title: The Lynceus pulled a folded lead tablet out of a child's grave in Pagasae & the Agora: Kra
item.description: The Lynceus pulled a folded lead tablet out of a child's grave in Pagasae & the Agora: Kratippos #7304 had written Chrysos #3498 the Twice-Born's name on it, with the words "I bind Chrysos #3498 the Twice-Born, the tongue, the hands, the work".

item.title: Dorkrates #232 of the House of Pelorus fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meado
item.description: Dorkrates #232 of the House of Pelorus fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Broken, not dead: Dormedes #3877 (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom).
item.description: Broken, not dead: Dormedes #3877 (fell in the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.description: Nikstratos #1681 and Kteion #9638 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget.
